useCase: Identifying GAN-generated images and attributing them to specific AI model architectures. Critical for 딥페이크 감지 and content provenance.
mechanism:
The 감지 process:

1. **Spectral 특징 extraction**: Computes the 2D FFT power 스펙트럼 and extracts azimuthally-averaged frequency profiles unique to each GAN architecture.

2. **Architecture-specific 패턴**: Different GAN architectures (StyleGAN, ProGAN, BigGAN, CycleGAN) produce distinct spectral fingerprints due to their specific upsampling and normalization layers.

3. **Fingerprint classification**: A multi-class SVM classifier trained on spectral 특징 식별 both the presence of GAN 아티팩트 and the specific architecture.

4. **Cross-model validation**: Results are cross-validated against a database of known GAN spectral signatures.
accuracy: Very 높음 - 92-98% for known GAN architectures. Accuracy decreases for novel or fine-tuned architectures.
name: GAN 핑거프린트 감지
parameters:
FFT: 256x256 power 스펙트럼
특징 추출: azimuthal averaging + radial profiles
Classifier: Multi-class SVM with RBF kernel
Known architectures: StyleGAN1/2/3, ProGAN, BigGAN, CycleGAN, StarGAN, DCGAN
description: 식별합니다 unique spectral fingerprints left by Generative Adversarial Networks. Each GAN architecture produces characteristic frequency-domain 패턴 in generated images that serve as reliable 포렌식 identifiers.

references.title: Marra, F. et al. (2019). Do GANs Leave Artificial Fingerprints? IEEE MIPR.
Yu, N. et al. (2019). Attributing Fake Images to GANs: Learning and Analyzing GAN Fingerprints. ICCV.
Frank, J. et al. (2020). Leveraging Frequency Analysis for Deep Fake Image Recognition. ICML.
Gragnaniello, D. et al. (2021). Are GAN Generated Images Easy to Detect? IEEE MMSP.

strengths:
• Extremely high 정확도 for known GAN families
• Can attribute images to specific GAN architectures
• Robust against common image transformations
• Works without requiring the original model
limitations:
• 새로운/알려지지 않은 GAN 아키텍처에는 덜 효과적
• 미세 조정된 모델은 지문을 변경할 수 있음
• 확산 모델은 다른 지문 특성을 가짐
• 강한 후처리가 지문을 저하시킬 수 있음
